patterns.name: log4shell_jndi_in_header
patterns.condition: A request header value contains a JNDI lookup expression using the ${jndi:...} form.
patterns.evidence: CVE-2021-44228 (Log4Shell) exploitation commonly used JNDI lookup strings in request headers; MITRE ATT&CK T1190 covers exploitation of a public-facing application.

patterns.name: log4shell_jndi_in_argument
patterns.condition: A request URL or parameter value contains a JNDI lookup expression using the ${jndi:...} form.
patterns.evidence: CVE-2021-44228 exploitation attempts may place JNDI lookup strings in request parameters; MITRE ATT&CK T1190 covers exploitation of a public-facing application.

patterns.name: known_vulnerability_probe_trace
patterns.condition: An alert explicitly describes a known-vulnerability checking tool or probe trace; do not infer this from a generic library name, the word jndi, a CVE name alone, or a partial expression.
patterns.evidence: The known-cve fixture includes an alert describing a checking-tool-like trace, and the task explicitly permits traces of known-vulnerability checking tools as a signal.
